review_notes: Readability cleanup of existing recovered code only; no new native coverage. Exact token substitution checks for alpha-only changes, focused branch and callback-order review for structured edits, and one combined incremental build. Full inventory and reccmp refresh remain deferred.

Commander 2018: preserve Aminatou battlefield scan and exchange order, Augury exile storage and type-choice behavior, Arixmethes cached land types and spell-trigger routing, and Entreat X payment. Replace Saheeli 151-byte marking clear and both Windgrace 28-byte message-tail clears with bounded memset. Include private totem_armor_any outside the old inventory.

Dissension: consolidate split-card dispatch while retaining availability queries, unusual resolution paths, mode re-reads after callbacks, AI priorities and native ID conversions. Preserve Error/Trial combat context checks, Experiment Kraj ability limits and shared activation callbacks, and Simic aura movement cleanup.

Urza Saga: preserve Bereavement discard order and fresh turn reads after callbacks, Sporogenesis attachment and death bookkeeping, Serra's Hymn duplicate-target handling, Fortitude regeneration checks, and multimana dispatch quirks. Replace Contamination pointer arithmetic with indexed writes to the same seven entries per player.
verification_policy: Affected-file hashes and exact token checks for alpha-only edits; focused review for structured edits. Build separately after the combined batch. Inventories and reccmp deferred to a larger checkpoint.
scope: Readability cleanup of existing recovered definitions; no new native coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim.
